scope: Original public mechanics prototype. No private story material.

tasks.title: Pinned A-Frame scene and same-origin assets
tasks.gate: Renderer starts and all runtime requests stay same-origin.

tasks.title: Two-hand draw, nock and pose-loss cancellation
tasks.gate: Real controller poses produce direction and power; losses never fire a stale arrow.

tasks.title: Swept arrows, cover and limited special ammunition
tasks.gate: Hits stop at nearest geometry and ammo changes only on valid shots.

tasks.title: Blink arrows and opt-in stick locomotion
tasks.gate: Landing footprint is clear; snap turns preserve the head pivot.

tasks.title: Connected seeded cloisters and branching paths
tasks.gate: 100 finite seed fixtures have reachable rooms, clear door centers and an exit.

tasks.title: Wardens, beacon, blessings and local renown
tasks.gate: An ordinary-input mission reaches the next sector; completion cannot be banked twice.

tasks.title: Spatial pause, handedness and shorter draw
tasks.gate: All essential actions can be completed in-headset, with cancelled inputs on transitions.

tasks.title: Quest 3 bow alignment and physical draw feel
tasks.gate: Record actual headset/browser version and both handedness tests. No API fixture substitutes.

tasks.title: Quest 3 sustained rendering and comfort
tasks.gate: Measure frame-time distribution, draw calls, thermal behavior, floor and snap turning on hardware.

tasks.title: Real Xbox and touch controllers
tasks.gate: Pair, reconnect, suspend and resume real USB/Bluetooth controllers and a phone.

tasks.title: Vertical rooms, stairs, towers and varied encounters
tasks.gate: Every intended route has a real traversable or teleport connection; no unreachable decorative islands.

tasks.title: Crossbow and physically loaded alternative weapon
tasks.gate: Reload gestures remain readable and comfortable in both hands.

tasks.title: Shield weak points and coordinated enemy behavior
tasks.gate: Enemies communicate intent without unavoidable or offscreen damage.

tasks.title: Refined original creatures, bow animation and spatial audio
tasks.gate: Artist/player review and hardware budget, not screenshot-only approval.

tasks.title: Save/resume a full run and broader unlocks
tasks.gate: Versioned bounded storage restores a run without duplicating rewards.

tasks.title: Player evaluation of difficulty and enjoyment
tasks.gate: Record first-run usability, fatigue and repeat-play feedback; counts do not certify fun.

tasks.title: Optional opt-in challenge sharing
tasks.gate: No accounts or remote data until explicitly designed and authorized.
